name: memorygraph
description: Search a local-first, source-backed memory graph for one Codex project.

interface.shortDescription: Recover exact conversations and review extracted memory.
interface.longDescription: MemoryGraph incrementally indexes one local Codex project, returns source-backed prompt and answer records, separates task ancestry from content similarity, and extracts reviewable memory candidates with Turn-level provenance.
defaultPrompt: Find an original answer in the current project's MemoryGraph
Verify this result with its task ID and Turn ID
Show task branches and content relationships for the current project
Extract reviewable memory candidates from source records
